title: New Year Domino
statementMd:
Celebrating the new year, many people post videos of falling dominoes; Here's a list of them: `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=New+Years+Dominos`

User ainta, who lives in a 2D world, is going to post a video as well.

There are $*n*$ dominoes on a 2D Cartesian plane. $*i*$-th domino ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) can be represented as a line segment which is parallel to the $*y*$-axis and whose length is $*l*_{*i*}$. The lower point of the domino is on the $*x*$-axis. Let's denote the $*x*$-coordinate of the $*i*$-th domino as $*p*_{*i*}$. Dominoes are placed one after another, so $*p*_{1} < *p*_{2} < ... < *p*_{*n* - 1} < *p*_{*n*}$ holds.

User ainta wants to take a video of falling dominoes. To make dominoes fall, he can push a single domino to the right. Then, the domino will fall down drawing a circle-shaped orbit until the line segment totally overlaps with the x-axis.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13cdfefb34292b0de2b0cd92583da18a19444065.png)

Also, if the $*s*$-th domino touches the $*t*$-th domino while falling down, the $*t*$-th domino will also fall down towards the right, following the same procedure above. Domino $*s*$ touches domino $*t*$ if and only if the segment representing $*s*$ and $*t*$ intersects.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0cafd2d319b8b9da7e1d8fb1ee27aa8f9cd45b3c.png)

See the picture above. If he pushes the leftmost domino to the right, it falls down, touching dominoes (A), (B) and (C). As a result, dominoes (A), (B), (C) will also fall towards the right. However, domino (D) won't be affected by pushing the leftmost domino, but eventually it will fall because it is touched by domino (C) for the first time.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/12f976cc801e3ace24a676d17430487dc5413cc8.png)

The picture above is an example of falling dominoes. Each red circle denotes a touch of two dominoes.

User ainta has $*q*$ plans of posting the video. $*j*$-th of them starts with pushing the $*x*_{*j*}$-th domino, and lasts until the $*y*_{*j*}$-th domino falls. But sometimes, it could be impossible to achieve such plan, so he has to lengthen some dominoes. It costs one dollar to increase the length of a single domino by $1$. User ainta wants to know, for each plan, the minimum cost needed to achieve it. Plans are processed independently, i. e. if domino's length is increased in some plan, it doesn't affect its length in other plans. Set of dominos that will fall except $*x*_{*j*}$-th domino and $*y*_{*j*}$-th domino doesn't matter, but the initial push should be on domino $*x*_{*j*}$.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$)— the number of dominoes.

Next $*n*$ lines describe the dominoes. The $*i*$-th line ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) contains two space-separated integers $*p*_{*i*}$, $*l*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*}, *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$)— the $*x*$-coordinate and the length of the $*i*$-th domino. It is guaranteed that $*p*_{1} < *p*_{2} < ... < *p*_{*n* - 1} < *p*_{*n*}$.

The next line contains an integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$) — the number of plans.

Next $*q*$ lines describe the plans. The $*j*$-th line ($1 ≤ *j* ≤ *q*$) contains two space-separated integers $*x*_{*j*}$, $*y*_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*j*} < *y*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$). It means the $*j*$-th plan is, to push the $*x*_{*j*}$-th domino, and shoot a video until the $*y*_{*j*}$-th domino falls.

## Output

For each plan, print a line containing the minimum cost needed to achieve it. If no cost is needed, print 0.

## Note

Consider the example. The dominoes are set like the picture below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3d53e184f13bfaaeeb9618f2bdf3e0e6139b394b.png)

Let's take a look at the 4th plan. To make the 6th domino fall by pushing the 2nd domino, the length of the 3rd domino (whose x-coordinate is 4) should be increased by 1, and the 5th domino (whose x-coordinate is 9) should be increased by 1 (other option is to increase 4th domino instead of 5th also by 1). Then, the dominoes will fall like in the picture below. Each cross denotes a touch between two dominoes.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/81c6220ce3ce181da9a12db5198028d656457e88.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ceaf770f752f420631bb64b00fccef82c687c5f4.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c120531e1d21f4c826a21f1cdb3a368d39857300.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7a8dbb77b47a2eeb29495a9c8fd44ffd815cc3a8.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/144427601515c081be4e1ae710a69d94bf4c114f.png)
statementZhMd:
庆祝新年时，许多人会发布多米诺骨牌倒下的视频；这里是相关视频列表：`https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=New+Years+Dominos`

生活在二维世界中的用户 ainta 也打算发布这样一段视频。

二维笛卡尔平面上有 $*n*$ 个多米诺骨牌。第 $*i*$ 个多米诺骨牌（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）可以表示为一条平行于 $*y*$ 轴、长度为 $*l*_{*i*}$ 的线段。多米诺骨牌的下端位于 $*x*$ 轴上。将第 $*i*$ 个多米诺骨牌的 $*x*$ 坐标记为 $*p*_{*i*}$。多米诺骨牌从左到右依次排列，因此满足 $*p*_{*1} < *p*_{*2} < ... < *p*_{*n* - 1} < *p*_{*n*}$。

用户 ainta 想要拍摄一段多米诺骨牌倒下的视频。为了让多米诺骨牌倒下，他可以将一个多米诺骨牌向右推倒。随后，该多米诺骨牌会沿圆形轨迹倒下，直到整条线段完全与 $x$ 轴重合。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/13cdfefb34292b0de2b0cd92583da18a19444065.png)

此外，如果第 $*s*$ 个多米诺骨牌在倒下过程中触碰到第 $*t*$ 个多米诺骨牌，那么第 $*t*$ 个多米诺骨牌也会按照上述过程向右倒下。当且仅当表示第 $*s*$ 个和第 $*t*$ 个多米诺骨牌的线段相交时，称第 $*s*$ 个多米诺骨牌触碰到了第 $*t*$ 个多米诺骨牌。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0cafd2d319b8b9da7e1d8fb1ee27aa8f9cd45b3c.png)

如上图所示，如果将最左边的多米诺骨牌向右推倒，它会触碰多米诺骨牌 (A)、(B) 和 (C)。因此，多米诺骨牌 (A)、(B)、(C) 也会向右倒下。然而，多米诺骨牌 (D) 不会受到推倒最左边多米诺骨牌的影响，但最终它会因为首次被多米诺骨牌 (C) 触碰而倒下。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/12f976cc801e3ace24a676d17430487dc5413cc8.png)

上图展示了多米诺骨牌倒下的过程。每个红色圆圈表示两个多米诺骨牌之间的一次触碰。

用户 ainta 有 $*q*$ 个发布视频的计划。第 $*j*$ 个计划从推倒第 $*x*_{*j*}$ 个多米诺骨牌开始，直到第 $*y*_{*j*}$ 个多米诺骨牌倒下为止。但有时可能无法直接实现某个计划，因此他需要加长一些多米诺骨牌。将一个多米诺骨牌的长度增加 $1$ 需要花费 1 美元。对于每个计划，用户 ainta 想知道实现该计划所需的最小花费。各个计划相互独立，也就是说，在某个计划中增加多米诺骨牌的长度不会影响其他计划中的长度。除了第 $*x*_{*j*}$ 个和第 $*y*_{*j*}$ 个多米诺骨牌之外，哪些多米诺骨牌会倒下并不重要，但最初必须推倒第 $*x*_{*j*}$ 个多米诺骨牌。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$），表示多米诺骨牌的数量。

接下来 $*n*$ 行描述这些多米诺骨牌。第 $*i*$ 行（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*p*_{*i*}$ 和 $*l*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*}, *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），分别表示第 $*i*$ 个多米诺骨牌的 $*x*$ 坐标和长度。保证 $*p*_{*1} < *p*_{*2} < ... < *p*_{*n* - 1} < *p*_{*n*}$。

下一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$），表示计划的数量。

接下来 $*q*$ 行描述这些计划。第 $*j*$ 行（$1 ≤ *j* ≤ *q*$）包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{*j*}$ 和 $*y*_{*j*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*j*} < *y*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$）。这表示第 $*j*$ 个计划是推倒第 $*x*_{*j*}$ 个多米诺骨牌，并拍摄视频直到第 $*y*_{*j*}$ 个多米诺骨牌倒下。

## 输出格式

对于每个计划，输出一行一个整数，表示实现该计划所需的最小花费。如果不需要花费，输出 0。

## 说明

考虑如下样例。多米诺骨牌的摆放方式如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3d53e184f13bfaaeeb9618f2bdf3e0e6139b394b.png)

下面来看第 4 个计划。为了通过推倒第 2 个多米诺骨牌使第 6 个多米诺骨牌倒下，需要将第 3 个多米诺骨牌（其 $x$ 坐标为 4）的长度增加 1，并将第 5 个多米诺骨牌（其 $x$ 坐标为 9）的长度增加 1（也可以将第 4 个多米诺骨牌的长度增加 1，而不是增加第 5 个多米诺骨牌的长度）。这样，多米诺骨牌会按照下图所示的方式倒下。每个叉号表示两个多米诺骨牌之间的一次触碰。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/81c6220ce3ce181da9a12db5198028d656457e88.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ceaf770f752f420631bb64b00fccef82c687c5f4.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c120531e1d21f4c826a21f1cdb3a368d39857300.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7a8dbb77b47a2eeb29495a9c8fd44ffd815cc3a8.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/144427601515c081be4e1ae710a69d94bf4c114f.png)
